content: Amazon Associates Operating Agreement forbids cloaking/hiding/spoofing the URL of the site containing Special Links (including via Redirecting Links) such that Amazon cannot determine the originating site. Community/vendor consensus (Geniuslink, Lasso): a first-party /go/slug 302 on your own domain that preserves the Tracking ID and clearly leads to Amazon is compliant; what is banned is obscuring the referring site or stripping the tag. Generic third-party shorteners that hide the destination are the risky pattern.
